scope: Nine bounded CPU time-series operations;partial JMP19.2 numerical coverage. General Gaussian Kalman is separate from six additive innovations ETS families. True rational transfer and exact stationary small-order ARMA prewhitening are separate from existing CSS arima.rs.
integration_status: Public execute/formal tests,production exported C ABI fixtures and matching native SQL PASS;bounded partial contracts only

common_contract.finite_data: Complete finite equally spaced numeric data;no SQL NULL/NaN missing sentinel except explicit Kalman observed0/1 flag. All matrix lengths and model versions checked;finite output failures reject.
common_contract.normal_intervals: Confidence .5..0.9999,normal quantile approximation;conditional process/measurement uncertainty only. No fitted parameter/variance-estimation or future-input uncertainty.
common_contract.ets_portable_layout: prediction_model=[1,1,k,y_origin,y_scale,standardized_sigma2,last_state(k),F(k*k),w(k),g(k)],row-major,length6+3k+k*k,k<=32. Positive scale/sigma2. Tag1 is shared additive innovations;tag0 independent Gaussian. F/w/g may represent a supplied linear additive innovations model;predict does not verify one of the six fitted ETS family structures.
common_contract.optimizer: Deterministic bounded Nelder-Mead with3startsETS/prewhite,4transfer. Stop requires maximum simplex coordinate spread<max(tol^.75,1e-8) and objective spread<.01*tol*(1+abs objective),then finite difference projected gradient<max(sqrt(tol),1e-7) in raw u coordinates. h=1e-5 score check. Objective is profile log(sigma2)+logdet/n (ETS logdet0). maxiter perstart;returned iterations is winning start. Local optimizer,not proof of global optimum.
common_contract.identification: Initial/GLS design reorthogonalized QR,relative column threshold1e-11. Local profile shape curvature central differencesh1e-4 on free face,Cholesky relative pivot threshold1e-14. Active legitimate faces condition the curvature;guards disqualify convergence. No SEs or global identification guarantee.
common_contract.resource: Gaussian k<=8,n<=5000,h<=500. ETS period<=24,n*k*k<=2000000,n*k*k*maxiter<=250000000. Prewhite n<=2000,n*maxiter*(1+p+q)<=40000000. Transfer n<=2000,n*maxiter*(1+den+p+q)<=60000000. These are nominal preflight work limits;multi-start/line-search/curvature evaluations add bounded work. Params<=16384 at native layer.
common_contract.JMP_gaps: X11 is NOT implemented or renamed from moving-average decomposition. Multiplicative ETS/automatic search/full admissibility,seasonal/integrated/multiple-input transfer and prewhitening,automatic lag selection,parameter uncertainty,and full report diagnostics remain. Existing CSS ARIMA module is untouched. Exact JMP CCF normalization/default optimizer/transfer numerator parameterization equivalence not asserted.
common_contract.external_covariance_validation: External initial/process/saved Gaussian covariances must be exactly symmetric in binary64. Scaled semidefinite Cholesky rejects any negative diagonal pivot or nonzero residual off-diagonal under a zero pivot; roundoff-ambiguous real-PSD matrices may reject, so callers must explicitly supply representable well-conditioned covariance. No near-PSD projection is performed. Initial covariance additionally needs scaled pivots>1e-14. Internal RTS rounding validation remains a separate tolerant numeric check.

operations.description: Known scalar-observation Gaussian Kalman filtering/RTS smoothing: [y,observed0/1] rows; [k,horizon,confidence,m0,P0,F,Q,H,R] row-major; k<=8,n<=5000,h<=500.
operations.data: 1..5000 rows [finite response, observed flag0/1]. Flag0 ignores response placeholder but retains elapsed time; SQL NULL is invalid.
args: P0: k*k proper positive-definite covariance row-major
Q: k*k positive-semidefinite process covariance row-major
operations.estimator: alpha0~N(m0,P0) is prior for observation0; alpha(t+1)=F alpha(t)+eta,Q; y(t)=H alpha(t)+epsilon,R. Independent process/measurement disturbances. Exact innovations Gaussian likelihood,Joseph filtering covariance,RTS smoothing via positive-definite solves. Singular predicted covariance needed by RTS rejects; no pseudoinverse. Future variance propagates final filtered covariance with Q; observation variance adds R. Output covariance matrices are flattened row-major inside one row per time.
unsupported: This general independent-noise Gaussian model is distinct from JMP ETS.

operations.description: Fit 6 additive innovations ETS families: scalar rows; [family0..5,period,horizon,confidence,maxiter,tol]. Estimated initial states,shared innovations ML and forecast intervals; bounded partial ETS.
operations.data: 8..5000 complete finite scalar rows; n>=2*k+4 with k=1+trend+seasonal_period. Nonconstant data and nondegenerate residual variance required.
args: family0 ANN/1 AAN/2 AAdN/3 ANA/4 AAA/5 AAdA;default0
period2..24 if seasonal,else unused0..24;default4 seasonal/0 otherwise
operations.estimator: y_t=w*x_(t-1)+e_t,x_t=F*x_(t-1)+g*e_t with shared e iidN(0,sigma2). For fixed smoothing parameters,rank-safe QR profiles all initial states with sum-zero initial seasonals. Conditional innovations Gaussian ML sigma2=SSE/n,three-start bounded Nelder-Mead plus independent projected-score check. alpha=.0001+.9998u,beta=alpha*u,gamma=(1-alpha)*u,phi=.8+.2u for damped. Alpha guard contact prevents combined convergence;beta/gamma0 and phi.8/1 are legitimate constrained faces. Local free-face profile curvature must be PD for combined convergence;no parameter SE is returned. Nominal parameter count includes smoothing parameters,independent initial states and sigma2,even on an active face. AIC/BIC null if nonconverged/guarded/unidentified. Future observation variance sigma2*(1+sum_(j=0..h-2)(w*F^j*g)^2),conditional on estimated initial state and point parameters.
unsupported: automatic ETS model selection/full admissibility region or exact JMP optimizer defaults
bounds are an explicit partial ETS contract;no full JMP family equivalence

operations.description: Reuse tagged Gaussian or additive-innovations ETS prediction_model: one ignored scalar placeholder row; [horizon,confidence,model...],h<=500. Models preserve final state and uncertainty convention.
operations.data: Exactly one finite scalar placeholder row [[0.]] for SQL/native use,ignored. Empty data accepted only at direct module layer.
args: unchanged prediction_model from kalman_smoother or state_space_smoothing; portable layouts in common_contract
operations.estimator: Gaussian forecasts transition final filtered state/covariance and add process Q each step,measurement R to observation variance. ETS forecasts deterministic final state plus shared-innovation convolution. Gaussian latent variance is conditional state measurement variance;ETS latent variance excludes the new observation innovation. Scaling uses standard deviations before squaring to avoid overflowing intermediate scale^2. Positive physical variance below representable range rejects.
unsupported: saved transfer-function reuse is not provided by this operation

operations.description: Conditional normal ARIMA forecast intervals from supplied means and A/C/difference polynomials: [confidence,sigma2,degreeA,degreeC,nD,A...,C...,difference_lags...],h<=1000.
args: one integer lag1..100 per factor;combined denominator length<=500
operations.estimator: D(B)=product(1-B^lag),psi(B)=C(B)/(A(B)D(B)),psi0=1. Conditional forecast error variance at h=sigma2*sum_(j=0..h-1)psi_j^2. Point means are supplied,not refitted. Existing arima.rs uses CSS;these extra intervals do not relabel its estimator exact ML. finite-horizon unstable polynomials allowed if representable.

operations.description: CCF for complete input/output rows: [maxlag<=500,normalization0global/1overlapPearson]; positive lag means input leads output; +/-2 white-noise SE bands.
operations.data: 3..10000 finite [input,output] rows;both nonconstant;overlap Pearson mode also rejects constant overlaps.
operations.estimator: Positive lag k pairs X_t with Y_(t+k). Global mode uses full-series centered energies in denominator. Pearson mode re-centers each overlap. Returns n-|k|overlaps and white-noise SE1/sqrt(n-|k|),two-SE marginal bands;these do not adjust multiple lag selection or prove input whiteness. Stable origin/scale normalization.
unsupported: exact JMP finite-sample normalization equivalence is unverified

operations.description: Input-only exact stationary ARMA prewhitening: [X,Y] rows; [n_train,p<=2,q<=2,maxlag,maxiter,tol]. Apply the same innovations operator to both series; suffix ignored.
operations.data: Finite [input,output] rows<=10000,n_train12..min(2000,n). Both parameter estimation and output centering use training prefix only. Constant input rejects;constant output allowed with null CCF.
operations.estimator: Fit input mean,ARMA coefficients and innovation variance by exact stationary Gaussian likelihood. Small companion-state covariance solves the stationary Lyapunov series by doubling;shared Kalman startup gains whiten all columns. Input mean profiles by GLS;output centers by ordinary training mean,and applies the SAME input-estimated whitening matrix,not a separate output fit. Returned innovations are physical-unit innovations with unit-noise-covariance whitening,not divided by fitted innovation sigma. CCF is nested under ccf;constant output returns null. PACF coordinates ensure stationary/invertible factors with guards abs(kappa)<=.98;guard contact prevents combined convergence. Same local optimizer/free-face curvature criteria as transfer.
unsupported: automatic order selection,whiteness proofs or complete model diagnostics

operations.description: Single-input rational omega/delta transfer with exact stationary ARMA noise: [X,Y] rows inclfutureX; [n_train,delay,numdegree<=2,dendegree<=2,p<=2,q<=2,h,confidence,maxiter,tol].
operations.data: Exactly n_train+horizon finite [input,output] rows,n_train20..2000,horizon1..500. Training input/output must be nonconstant with nondegenerate fitted residual variance. Future input path required;future output values are ignored. No automatic lag/order selection.
operations.estimator: v_t=sum(delta_j*v_(t-j))+sum(omega_j*(X_(t-delay-j)-training_input_mean));Y_t=intercept+v_t+n_t;phi(B)n=theta(B)e. Zero centered-input presample transfer state is explicit;ARMA-noise initial covariance is stationary. For given stable delta and stationary/invertible ARMA,profile intercept/omega/sigma2 by exact Gaussian GLS QR;four-start bounded local optimization over shape PACFs. Returned delta and AR arrays use positive recurrence coefficients,MA array uses theta(B)=1+theta1B+...;numerator degree d has d+1 omega entries. Forecasts add conditional ARMA-noise mean to deterministic specified-input transfer. Exact stationary-noise Gaussian LL,not CSS/independent-error OLS. Parameter count=denorder+p+q+numerator_degree+3. AIC/BIC null when nonconverged/guarded/unidentified. Free profile-shape curvature is a local identification diagnostic,not full covariance or global optimality proof.
unsupported: multiple inputs,seasonal/differenced noise or missing data
automatic lag/order selection or exact JMP numerator convention/default optimizer equivalence
portable transfer prediction carrier is not yet exposed

operations.description: Remove least-squares intercept+slope from equally spaced scalar series: [n_train=all],training-only stable centering/scaling and extrapolated trend.
operations.data: 3..10000 finite scalar rows;zero-based implicit time index0..n-1.
operations.estimator: Rank-safe QR on centered/scaled time;fit uses prefix only,extrapolates all row indices. Returns intercept,slope,trend,residuals and stable coefficient representation prediction_model=[1,y_origin,y_scale,b0,b1,time_mid,time_scale];this carrier is metadata,not accepted by state_space_predict.
unsupported: iid slope inference in autocorrelated errors

operations.description: Remove one fixed-period cosine/sine cycle: scalar series; [period>2,include_constant=1,n_train=all]. Return amplitude/phase; phase null for numerical zero cycle.
operations.data: 4..10000 finite scalar rows;zero-based implicit equally spaced time index.
operations.estimator: Rank-safe QR on cos(2*pi*t/period),sin(...),optionalconstant. Component includes fitted constant when requested. Amplitude=hypot(coscoef,sincoef),phase=atan2(-sincoef,coscoef),so component=intercept+amplitude*cos(wt+phase). Phase null when amplitude<=1e-12*training_scale. Prefix fit predicts all indices;no automatic frequency selection.
unsupported: irregular time/calendar effects or iid inference
